title: Source-only binary attack transfer from SCVIC to APT Sandworm
training: Reuse exactly the original E1 192-row fitting support for each seed, including 32 NormalTraffic examples; fit the median imputer only on those source rows. No Sandworm-derived fitting, normalization, feature selection, calibration, tuning or choice of model.
comparator_selection: Reuse the original E1 inner-three-fold-CV winner between XGBoost and LightGBM per seed, with original selected parameters; exact ties select XGBoost. Audit original cell and support receipts. Do not use any source-test or target score for selection.
foundation_configuration: Unchanged E1 TabICL v2 checkpoint/backend, four estimators, same source class order, explicit CPU, n_jobs=1 and 1024-row prediction chunks. Record checkpoint, backend, interpreter and dependency hashes/versions in prefit evidence.
primary_query: All 2091 unique ordered73-feature rows, sorted by canonical predictor SHA256. Query batches are frozen because foundation probabilities can depend on the query context. The deduplicated view is primary.
raw_sensitivity: Reweight each fixed unique-query prediction by its raw_to_unique multiplicity, reconstructing 2133 raw-flow counts. This is not a separate raw-order query execution and does not imply equivalent foundation probabilities under different batching.
target_labels: Normal maps to0; every author-labeled attack procedure maps to1. Report each original procedure string separately. Do not map procedures to SCVIC six-stage labels or claim actor attribution.
aggregation: Report all ten paired source-subsampling seeds, arithmetic means and seed ranges, unique and raw-multiplicity views. These are repeated fits on one target capture, not ten independent incidents. No significance or population confidence claim from the seeds.
decision_interpretation: Descriptive external binary-transfer evidence. No newly chosen pass threshold and no six-stage or rare-stage validation claim. Publish negative, mixed and positive outcomes alike.

source_only_threshold_diagnostic.source_partition: Original E1 calibration NormalTraffic rows only, 29929 labels per seed/model; no target labels or target scores used in threshold choice
source_only_threshold_diagnostic.threshold: Sort source-normal calibration scores ascending, n=29929; choose one-based rank ceil(0.99*(n+1)) and call an attack only if target score is strictly greater than this threshold. Infinite threshold if rank exceeds n. Ties remain normal.
source_only_threshold_diagnostic.scope: Secondary fixed-source operating-point diagnostic, after matching full source-calibration predictions are available. A 1% source calibration target does not guarantee 1% target false alarms under domain shift. Primary argmax outcomes remain the primary report.

rights: Zenodo API/license field lists CC-BY4.0; landing copyright text says CC-BY-NC-ND4.0. Keep original and derived data private for this noncommercial evaluation; publish only code, provenance, hashes and aggregate measurements. See the rights amendment and holdout qualification.
limitations: Single 2025-02-18 critical-infrastructure emulation with37 labeled attack flows; five procedures have16,8,7,5 and1 flows. It cannot establish stage-specific generalization or broad incident-level performance.
Only network-visible attack procedures were labeled; endpoint-only stages are outside the author flow labels. No exfiltration class exists in this flow CSV.
All73 predictor names and field meanings align, but exact CICFlowMeter versions/settings and implementation equivalence are unqualified. This external test includes extractor and environment shift.
Exact predictor overlap with SCVIC is zero; this does not eliminate correlations among flows within either capture or certify near-duplicate independence.
Author labels are accepted, not independently human-adjudicated. No foundation pretraining-overlap guarantee is available.
Balanced32-per-class source fitting, including NormalTraffic, is retained for comparability; abundant-benign fitting remains a different experiment.
This transfer comparison does not test missing or delayed telemetry, early warning, or a new rare-stage protection method.
